periodictimer-loop.title: Write asynchronous periodic loops with PeriodicTimer
periodictimer-loop.summary: PeriodicTimer exposes recurring ticks through WaitForNextTickAsync.
periodictimer-loop.why: Periodic work can be written as a normal async loop rather than overlapping callbacks.
periodictimer-loop.tips: Account for work duration relative to the period and use cancellation and disposal for shutdown.

frozenset-lookup.title: Optimize read-only set lookup with FrozenSet
frozenset-lookup.short: Freeze stable data for repeated membership tests
frozenset-lookup.summary: FrozenSet<T> is an immutable set representation optimized for lookup after construction.
frozenset-lookup.why: It suits data initialized once and queried with Contains many times.
frozenset-lookup.tips: Construction has a cost, so benchmark against HashSet for small or frequently rebuilt sets.

sequencereader-parse.title: Parse segmented buffers with SequenceReader<T>
sequencereader-parse.short: Advance through ReadOnlySequence without concatenating segments
sequencereader-parse.summary: SequenceReader<T> provides cursor-style parsing helpers over a segmented ReadOnlySequence<T>.
sequencereader-parse.why: Segmented data can be parsed without copying every segment into one array.
sequencereader-parse.tips: Check each API's advancement behavior on failure and treat incomplete input as a normal parsing case.

objectdisposedexception-throwif.title: Guard disposed state with ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf
objectdisposedexception-throwif.short: Reject use after disposal with the standard exception
objectdisposedexception-throwif.summary: ThrowIf checks a disposed-state condition and throws ObjectDisposedException when the object can no longer be used.
objectdisposedexception-throwif.why: IDisposable implementations can express a common guard without repeating exception construction.
objectdisposedexception-throwif.tips: Use it at operations that are invalid after disposal, not merely to reject repeated Dispose calls.

timeprovider-createtimer.title: Create timers through TimeProvider.CreateTimer
timeprovider-createtimer.short: Build a timer from a testable source of time
timeprovider-createtimer.summary: CreateTimer returns an ITimer associated with a TimeProvider.
timeprovider-createtimer.why: Timer behavior can use the same time abstraction as clock reads, improving testability.
timeprovider-createtimer.tips: Design for callback overlap and disposal; compare PeriodicTimer for straightforward sequential async loops.

xxhash3-hash.title: Compute fast non-cryptographic hashes with XxHash3
xxhash3-hash.short: Hash bulk data quickly for lookup or partitioning
xxhash3-hash.summary: XxHash3 computes a high-speed non-cryptographic hash of data.
xxhash3-hash.why: It fits content lookup, partitioning, and other bulk operations that do not require cryptographic strength.
xxhash3-hash.tips: Use SHA-256 or HMAC instead for signatures, secrets, or adversarial integrity checks.

base64url-encode.title: Encode URL-friendly Base64 with Base64Url
base64url-encode.short: Represent binary values safely in URLs and tokens
base64url-encode.summary: Base64Url encodes and decodes the URL-safe Base64 alphabet.
base64url-encode.why: Binary identifiers can be embedded in URLs, cookies, and tokens without the troublesome characters of ordinary Base64.
base64url-encode.tips: Encoding is not encryption; use a separate security mechanism for confidential data.

path-exists.title: Check for either files or directories with Path.Exists
path-exists.short: Test path existence without choosing File or Directory first
path-exists.summary: Path.Exists reports whether a path currently identifies an existing file or directory.
path-exists.why: Existence checks that do not care about the entry type can use one API.
path-exists.tips: The target can change immediately after the check, so still handle failures from the real operation.

gc-refresh-memory-limit.title: Reload GC memory limits with GC.RefreshMemoryLimit
gc-refresh-memory-limit.short: Apply changed GC heap-limit settings at runtime
gc-refresh-memory-limit.summary: RefreshMemoryLimit reloads supported GC memory-limit settings from AppContext.
gc-refresh-memory-limit.why: Advanced hosted applications can react when an operational memory limit changes while the process remains alive.
gc-refresh-memory-limit.tips: Most applications do not need this API; validate operational settings carefully because invalid limits can fail.

iutf8spanformattable-tryformat.title: Format directly to UTF-8 with IUtf8SpanFormattable
iutf8spanformattable-tryformat.short: Write values to UTF-8 buffers without an intermediate string
iutf8spanformattable-tryformat.summary: IUtf8SpanFormattable defines formatting directly into Span<byte> containing UTF-8 data.
iutf8spanformattable-tryformat.why: UTF-8 network and storage paths can avoid an intermediate string and subsequent encoding step.
iutf8spanformattable-tryformat.tips: Prefer ordinary formatting first and use this contract where measurements show allocation matters.
